files.author: Ian Poellet
files.caption:
The historic Gustavus Holmes House (built 1892), located at 682 34th Street in Astoria, Oregon, United States, is listed on the US National Register of Historic Places.





This is an image of a place or building that is listed on the National Register of Historic Places in the United States of America. Its reference number is 84000121 (Wikidata).
